turns.assessment: The contemporaneous AMP_INPUT_LOS at the second amplifier on S08→S24 localizes the optical loss to the immediately preceding fibre span. The booster’s input/output power and pump current did not change, ruling strongly against the booster or the OMS input patch. A sudden hard loss across all channels is most consistent with a cut of span 1, although the unchanged reverse direction makes a severe one-fibre loss a secondary possibility.

proposals.rationale: A cut in oms.S08-S24.span0 would leave amp0 output normal but cause input LOS at amp1, exactly matching O1 and the simultaneous service failures. The reverse fibre remaining normal slightly weakens, but does not overturn, this localization.
A sudden very large added loss in span0 could also drive amp1 input below detection while amp0 remains normal, and could affect only one direction.
Failure of the upstream booster could produce amp1 input LOS, but unchanged amp0 output power and pump current are strong contrary evidence.
